## Rules for every file

- **dates** — ISO, YYYY-MM-DD. Never 03/04 — that is two different days in two countries. A time goes in its own column as HH:MM (24h).
- **agentIdentity** — The CB number, in its own column, exactly as the Agent List spells it. CB-15, CB15 and cb 15 all normalise, so any of them is fine — a NAME alone is not, because two agents share one.
- **headerRow** — Exactly one header row, in row 1. No title banner above it, no merged cells, no colour-coded meaning, no blank spacer rows.
- **totals** — No totals row and no subtotal rows. The report does its own arithmetic and a totals row loads as a fake record.
- **oneRowPer** — Every file states its grain below and must hold to it — one row per thing, repeated for each thing. A row that summarises other rows breaks the load.
- **money** — Rands, plain numbers, no R and no thousands separator. State ex or incl VAT in the column name; never leave it to be guessed.
- **empty** — Leave a cell blank when there is no value. Never 0, never N/A, never a dash — an absence is not a nought, and the report is built to tell them apart.
- **naming** — <REQUEST_ID>_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx, dated for the period it describes, not the day it was exported.
- **delivery** — Drop into the Upload Station like any other export. A request marked `newSource` needs a SOURCES entry and a TRANSFORM mapping added first — that is our job, not the sender's.
- **history** — Send the whole register every time, not just what changed. Every one of these supersedes its own previous copy; none of them append.

These hold for EVERY file below. They are the same rules the Upload Station already enforces, so a file that follows them loads on the first try.

### 1. BLUE_ACTIONS — Blue export — tickets and actions
